name: Anarlog (formerly Hyprnote)
description: Local-first meeting notepad that listens to calls without a bot, transcribes them and merges the transcript with your own notes.
whatItDoes: Lets people take rough notes during a meeting while it records and transcribes in the background, then produces a cleaned-up summary. Nothing joins the call as a visible participant.
howItWorks: A desktop application built in Rust captures audio on the device and stores notes and transcripts in a local SQLite database. Transcription and summarisation can run on local models or a provider chosen by the user. The README documents the developer workflow for running the desktop app from source.

requirements.name: pnpm and Rust toolchain
requirements.description: Needed to run the desktop app from source
